spanish: Y grasa de cadáver y grasa de despedazado se hará a toda obra, y de ningún modo la comerán.

findings.issue: Niphal יֵעָשֶׂה plus לְ marks the fat as done for every work; «se hará a» can be read as done to the work as patient rather than for it as purpose.

notes: 2mp suffix verb as comerán is ustedes address; inf. abs. emphasis is de ningún modo; la tracks grasa.
